# Water Systems Bench

> A practical workflow hub for sizing, checking, troubleshooting and planning real-world water systems from source to use.

## Current implemented clusters

- [Pumps, Pressure & Pipe Flow](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/pumps-pressure-pipe/)
- [Wells, Storage & Rainwater](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/wells-storage-rainwater/)
- [Irrigation & Sprinkler Systems](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/irrigation-sprinklers/)
- [Water Treatment & Water Quality](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/water-treatment-quality/)
- [Greywater Reuse Planning](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/greywater-reuse/)
- [Vehicle Wash Water Reclaim Planning](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/vehicle-wash-water-reclaim/)
- [Metal Finishing Rinse Water Optimization](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/metal-finishing-rinse-water/)

## Safety and limitations

The site supports preliminary planning. Outputs are not formal engineering approval, potable-water certification, legal advice, manufacturer selection, or a universal regulatory determination. Verify measurements, accredited laboratory results, applicable requirements, official certified-product listings and current manufacturer data. Chemical dose and CT tools use user-supplied targets and never recommend legal or health values. Greywater tools never approve a source, potable use, plumbing connection, storage method, setback or jurisdictional compliance. Vehicle-wash tools never select treatment, approve reclaimed-water quality, or authorize wastewater, reject, backwash or sludge discharge. Metal-finishing tools never set chemistry, rinse acceptance, exposure or discharge limits.
